description: Free-to-play massively multiplayer first-person shooter. This package installs and removes it through Steam (app 218230); Steam keeps it updated.
notes: Steam does the work: 'scoop install' opens Steam's install dialog (pick the library there) and the download
continues in Steam after Scoop finishes; 'scoop uninstall' asks Steam to remove the game, and Steam asks you to confirm.
Steam updates the game itself, so this package has no versions to update.
The 'PlanetSide-2' command starts the game through Steam (steam://rungameid/218230).
If PlanetSide 2 is already in your Steam library and installed, Scoop just starts keeping track of it.
Stops if the standalone copy (Daybreak LaunchPad, package PlanetSide-2-LaunchPad) is installed: one copy of the game is enough.
pre_install: if (!$steamExe) { error 'Steam is not installed. Install it first (scoop install extras/steam, or from store.steampowered.com), sign in, then try again.'; break }

$standalone = Get-ChildItem $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like 'DGC-PlanetSide 2*' -or $_.PSChildName -eq 'PlanetSide 2' } | Get-ItemProperty -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { "$($_.InstallLocation)$($_.UninstallString)" -notlike '*\steamapps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1

if ($standalone) { error "The standalone PlanetSide 2 ($($standalone.DisplayName)) is installed. Remove it first (scoop uninstall PlanetSide-2-LaunchPad, or Settings > Apps), so there is only one copy of the game."; break }

script: if ($inSteam) { info 'PlanetSide 2 is already installed in Steam; Scoop keeps track of it from now on.'; return }
Write-Host 'Steam opened its install dialog for PlanetSide 2: choose a library there. The download continues in Steam.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host 'Steam asks you to confirm removing PlanetSide 2; the game files are deleted only after you confirm.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
